description: This file defines simulated in-memory repository classes for users, conversations, feedback, and documents, along with a bundle class that aggregates these repositories. It is used for testing or mocking data storage in a Python project.

classes.name: _UsersSim
classes.description: Simulated user repository implementing UsersRepo interface, managing user data in-memory.

classes.name: _ConversationsSim
classes.description: Simulated conversation repository implementing ConversationsRepo interface, managing conversation data in-memory.

classes.name: _FeedbackSim
classes.description: Simulated feedback repository implementing FeedbackRepo interface, managing feedback logs in-memory.

classes.name: _DocumentsSim
classes.description: Simulated documents repository implementing DocumentsRepo interface, managing document metadata in-memory.

classes.name: SimulatedRepoBundle
classes.description: Container class that aggregates all simulated repositories with in-memory collections.

methods.name: create_stub_if_missing
methods.description: Creates a user stub with default preferences if the user does not exist.

methods.name: add_conversation
methods.description: Adds a new conversation document to the in-memory collection, generating a unique ID.

methods.name: add_audit_log
methods.description: Adds an audit log document to the in-memory collection, generating a unique ID.

methods.name: add_document_meta
methods.description: Adds document metadata to the in-memory collection, generating a unique ID.
